scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp -R assets src phaser.js favicon.ico index.html dist/ && cp -R .well-known dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.ios:build: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphoneos CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO
